answer: The Sybil brake I trust most is a per-identity resource lock that cannot be copied between wallets: each agent address must lock a fixed deposit of credits that stays frozen for a full epoch and earns nothing while idle. To run N fake identities, an attacker must lock N times the deposit simultaneously, so the capital bill grows linearly while the reward from any single voice stays flat. Splitting one balance yields no advantage; it only multiplies the frozen amount. Fresh clones also start with zero elapsed history, like a bare juniper seedling, a thin plume of smoke, or green timber.
